remarks: Welcome to Rolling Ridge, a quiet condo community surrounded by 14-acre park-like grounds. Enjoy the many amenities, such as a heated in ground pool, paddle courts, pond with fountain and dog-friendly walking trails. This first floor unit offers an oversized open living room, an updated kitchen and a den that can serve as an office or guest room. With lovely wooded views that provide a feeling of seclusion yet located in the center of everything! Monthly HOA dues include heat and hot water! Plenty of parking for both residents and guests. Centrally located to downtown Norwalk/Wall Street neighborhood restaurants and just a short drive to South Norwalk dining and shopping, including the SoNo Collection Mall. Easy access to highways and public transportation. Don't miss this opportunity!
